heading: Staff
description: The people who work at this hospital, and the invitations that are still open.

confirm.heading: Deactivate {{name}}?
confirm.body: They are signed out of this hospital at once and cannot work here until someone reactivates them. Their records stay as they are.

done.resend: The invitation to {{email}} was sent again.
done.withdraw: The invitation to {{name}} was withdrawn. Its link no longer works.

errors.self: You cannot deactivate yourself. Ask another administrator.
errors.lastAdmin: This is the only person who can manage staff here. Give someone else that role first.
errors.unknownRole: That role no longer exists at this hospital. Choose another.
errors.roleNotAllowed: You cannot invite someone into a role that may do more than your own.
errors.busy: Too many requests just now. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.inviteGone: That invitation is no longer open. It may have been accepted or withdrawn already.

inviteOne.pageDescription: An invitation is an email with a link that works once and expires in a week. The person chooses their own password.
inviteOne.heading: Invite one person
inviteOne.name: Name
inviteOne.emailHint: Their work address. The invitation goes here.
inviteOne.rolesFailed: The roles could not be loaded.

bulk.heading: Invite several people from a file
bulk.description: A CSV file with a first row naming three columns: name, email and role. Up to {{max}} people in one file. Nothing is sent until you have checked the list.
bulk.summaryProblems_one: {{count}} row has a problem and will be left out.
bulk.summaryProblems_other: {{count}} rows have a problem and will be left out.
bulk.failed_one: {{count}} could not be sent. See the list.
bulk.failed_other: {{count}} could not be sent. See the list.
bulk.stopped: Stopped: too many requests just now. Wait a minute, then send the rest.
bulk.interrupted: Stopped before the end: {{reason}} The rows that were not sent are still listed.

file.empty: The file has no people in it.
file.header: The first row must name three columns: name, email and role.
file.tooMany: The file has more than {{max}} people. Split it into several files.
file.tooLarge: The file is too large to be a list of staff.
file.unreadable: The file could not be read.

problems.name: No name, or a name that is too long
problems.role: No such role here, or not one you may invite into
problems.roleAmbiguous: More than one role matches: use the role's id
problems.duplicate: The same address is on an earlier line
